verdict.rationale: Snyk Container is documented as a dedicated product to find and fix vulnerabilities in container images so images ship with security built in from the start. Snyk docs list container images among its scan targets, and it can scan images in private and self-hosted registries via the Broker Container Registry Agent (Enterprise-only). Container scanning is included in the plans, and the CLI runs in CI/CD for pre-deploy gating; one community comment relays second-hand praise for the container tools. missing for 10: explicit evidence distinguishing OS-package from application-layer dependency detection in images, a documented container-specific CLI command or pre-deploy gating workflow, hands-on independent corroboration.
